title: Cash-Flow Review | Accounting & Finance | BackOfficeFleet
description: Cash-flow review page for trucking finance teams connecting billing, receivables, settlements, factoring packet context, and blockers.
html:
Accounting & Finance / Cash-Flow Review

See what is ready to move and what is holding cash back.

Cash-flow visibility starts with operating status: invoice ready, packet missing, receivable aging, settlement hold, factoring support, customer dispute, or owner review.

Accounting & FinanceAccounts Receivable

Finance review

Aging is more useful when the office can see the reason.

BOF groups money movement by readiness, owner, document support, customer status, and next action.

Receivable signal

Explain why an invoice remains open.

Separate normal aging from disputed proof, missing accessorial approval, customer packet gap, claim review, or factoring readiness.

Owner action

Turn cash-flow concern into follow-up work.

Assign customer contact, document recovery, settlement review, billing correction, or leadership escalation.
